premises.text: Mobile phones' supercomputer power should enable interactive real-world games, not only tiny-screen play
premises.evidence_span: people would be pretty amazed back then to think we have basically the power of a supercomputer in our pocket and all they're doing is using it to play words with friends

premises.text: IR lighter plus light puck plus phone registers physical tag/mission gameplay such as Assassin
premises.evidence_span: we have the lighter. It shoots an infrared beam to the light puck. which immediately registers here and if you bring up the phone you can see that the mission has been completed

premises.text: Cloud platform relays gaming activity through the phone and internet
premises.evidence_span: totally cloud based platform, so all the gaming activity goes leverages the power of your phone. All that data is relayed through the Internet

premises.text: Open-source software and hardware let users develop games and 3D-print their own peripherals
premises.evidence_span: platform both being open source software and open source hardware. you're able to develop your own games and your own peripherals. You can use ours, or you can 3D print your own

premises.text: Sensor array (Bluetooth, IR, accelerometers) is programmable across game genres with developer kits for custom hardware
premises.evidence_span: the lighter utilizes an array of sensors, a Bluetooth, IR, accelerometers, and others that you can program for whatever type of game you want

premises.text: System automates the game master and allows custom rule sets while connecting IoT devices
premises.evidence_span: no longer do you need a game master for each of these interactive-type games. Now all of it's automated, and you have the ability to customize your own game with own rule sets

premises.text: Heads-up display relays real-time in-game stats such as health and teammate location
premises.evidence_span: integrated heads-up display. So now you can see all of your in-game stats, your health, any type of game information

premises.text: Monetize via own apps/peripherals/STL files and by hosting third-party game developers
premises.evidence_span: not only do we have our own apps that we're creating, and as you can see, the peripherals, as well as the STL files, but we're developing this as an open community and hosting the third-party game developers

value.text: Interactive physical multiplayer gaming that gets people looking up and playing with real people
value.evidence_span: get people to play mobile games without sitting there staring at this tiny little screen. We're trying to get them to look up, interact with real people

causal_links.evidence_span: what the new generation of gaming looks like
sensor based mobile gaming platform that allows completely interactive gaming anywhere in the world

notes: Kickstarter launch ask excluded as financing. Multiple game examples (Assassin, Invasion, Besieged) treated as applications of one sensor platform (v1.3.1 §4.1.2), not separate premises. Soft count at 8.

meta.provenance_note: Codebook-only prompt v1.3.1; temperature not API-controlled in this harness.
